rows.name: Universal credit: removing the two-child limit

conditions.measure: Universal credit: removing the two-child limit
conditions.pe_expressibility_note: The description reads 'removing the two-child limit', but the ~60m-a-year cost matches exempting children born before 6 April 2017 in UC (reg 24A(3) as reworded from 1 February 2019, cited in born_before.yaml), not abolishing the limit. Construction: modified baseline without the born_before exemption, current law 20170406.
conditions.pe_missing: No UC claim start date or transitional-protection status: the pre-measure rule would have applied the limit to children born before 6 April 2017 only in new claims, so dropping the born_before exemption in PE would hit continuing claims too.
